description: GREATEST/LEAST convert their arguments before ordering and answer with the CONVERTED value: a string joins the other family whichever side it is on (numbers, dates), BOOLEAN takes the ordering, a scalar VARIANT unwraps, ordinary same-family calls are untouched; an unreadable string fails per ROW in the account's words (Numeric value / Date ... is not recognized) while a BINARY beside another family is refused at COMPILE time naming the operand (the _IGNORE_NULLS spellings too), never leaking an internal exception, and a view over the same body is refused rather than created. Converted 1:1 from expressions/OrderingConditionalCoercionTest (now retired).
